response.rationale: DSRCT is characterized by small round cells with strong WT1 and variable CD99; Ewing/PNET typically show diffuse strong CD99 and WT1 negativity.

rejected.why: CD99 is patchy not diffuse; WT1 strong positivity favors DSRCT
Same as Ewing; lacks WT1 support and CD99 pattern atypical
Wilms tumor unlikely in adult with mediastinal mass and pulmonary nodules
